title: Molecular underpinnings of rheumatic diseases and emerging therapeutic concepts
title_zh: 风湿性疾病的分子基础与新兴治疗概念
abstract: Inflammatory rheumatic diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus represent chronic inflammatory disorders that are caused by dysregulation of innate and adaptive immune responses. Here we review current advances in our understanding of the molecular underpinnings of these diseases and discuss consequences with respect to emerging targets and treatment strategies, which are increasingly enabling more robust disease control and the first prospects of a cure for previously chronic inflammatory rheumatic diseases. Improved molecular insights into inflammatory rheumatic diseases are enabling better disease control and advancing the field towards achieving durable remission and eventual cure.
abstract_zh: 类风湿性关节炎、银屑病关节炎和系统性红斑狼疮等炎症性风湿性疾病是由先天性和适应性免疫反应失调引起的慢性炎症性疾病。我们回顾了对这些疾病分子基础理解的最新进展，并讨论了相关新兴靶点和治疗策略，这些策略越来越能够实现更强有力的疾病控制，并为曾经无法治愈的慢性炎症性风湿性疾病带来首次治愈的前景。对炎症性风湿性疾病分子机制的更深入了解，正在改善疾病控制，并推动该领域走向持久缓解乃至最终治愈。
